notes:
Faster takeoff, automatic takeoff, and working as a team.

**Takeoff tools**
- **Draw once for several conditions.** Shift-click floor, base and ceiling,
  outline the room once, and each gets its own quantity.
- **Doors and windows come off the wall.** Click an opening onto a wall run and
  the wall loses its width and its area.
- **Linked typicals.** Take off one unit, place it on every typical sheet, and
  change the original to change them all.
- **A legend on each sheet** with that sheet's quantities, printed with it.
- **Drops and round-up** per segment on linear conditions, for MEP runs.

**Automatic takeoff, on this Mac**
- **Rooms from their labels** (⇧R): net area and perimeter for every named room.
- **Walls from the drawing** (⇧W): centerline length from the plan's own lines.
- **Count a text** (⇧T): every D1 or WH-1 on the sheet or the whole set, exact.
- **Pattern search** (P): box a hatch and get every area filled with it.
- **Auto count** finds mirrored symbols, skips legends, and searches every sheet.
- Every result is a draft you review before it is added. Nothing is uploaded.

**Working together, through your team server**
- **Sign in first.** NXG now opens on a sign-in page. On your Mac: click
  *Start the team server on this Mac*, then create the Admin account. Invite
  your crew from Team ▾ → People…. In Settings → Team, tick *Other Macs in the
  office can connect* (and *Start it when this Mac starts*); teammates enter
  the address shown there and their invite code.
- **Several people on one job at once**: everyone draws, moves and prices at
  the same time and sees the others within a second — their marks, pointer and
  sheet. Undo takes back only your own changes. Dropped connection: keep
  working; it catches up.
- **Admin, Manager, Member.** Managers invite Members and decide per person:
  sees prices, edits rates, sends proposals, creates share links, sees all jobs.
  Someone who can't see prices never receives them.
- **Comments, statuses, lock and approve** on any mark; a live markups list
  with a summary PDF; a session record of who did what; @mentions.
- **Share links**: a client or sub opens the job in any browser — plans,
  markup, comments, never prices.
- **Jobs, price book and templates live on the server**, with versions you can
  restore and nightly backups of the server's folder.

**Also**
- **Help → NXG Takeoff Help** (⇧⌘/): a searchable guide.
- Scales read correctly off title blocks that put the date before the scale.
- Job cost's material/labor/sub budget covers only the work you were paid for.
